answer: Sample 4% of attestations each epoch. Auditors rotate every 3 epochs, drawn from a pool of 200. If 3 or more attestations arrive from one subnet, that batch is taxed 25% and re-sampled. Last close: 812 attestations, 33 sampled, 2 failed. Records sit on a quartz-hard log, a violet flag marks any subnet that trips the rule, and the sable list of flags is public. Limit: a patient attacker holding one account per subnet pays 25x hosting and stays invisible to the sampler.
